title: Replace a word
description:
Write a function `replace_word(text, old, new)` that returns `text` with every occurrence of `old` replaced by `new`.

Covers source items 11-12 (both are `.replace()` calls on different text) as one exercise.
hints: text.replace(old, new) returns a new string with every occurrence of old swapped for new - it doesn't modify text itself, since strings are immutable.
Call .replace() on text with old and new as its two arguments, and return the result.
expected_behavior: Returns text with every occurrence of old replaced by new.
solution:
def replace_word(text, old, new):
    return text.replace(old, new)
explanation: str.replace() scans the whole string and swaps every match in one call, returning a new string rather than mutating the original.
